name: obra/superpowers
hook: 178K stars — Jesse Vincent's five-phase structured development methodology for Claude Code: Brainstorm, Design (interactive HTML mockups), Plan (git-worktree task breakdown), Code (parallel subagents with 6-category self-check), Verify (security audit). Official Anthropic marketplace plugin. v2.1.136's new `settings.autoMode.hard_deny` enables unconditional blocking of risky operations during the Verify phase — previously auto-mode could only soft-deny, letting flagged actions slip through on retry.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 6 — 178K stars; v2.1.136 hard_deny classifier strengthens Verify-phase guardrails

name: Designer Skills Collection (Owl-Listener)

name: 9Router (decolua)
hook: 6.3K stars. Smart routing proxy that intercepts Claude Code requests and applies token compression before forwarding — saving 20–40% of token spend. Implements a 3-tier fallback: subscription providers (Claude/GPT) first, cheap options second, free tiers last, so coding continues uninterrupted when quotas deplete. Configure via `~/.claude/config.json` with `http://localhost:20128/v1` as the API base; all 40+ provider presets including all Claude model variants are pre-loaded. Dashboard opens automatically at `http://localhost:20128` with live quota tracking.

name: Claude for Microsoft 365
hook: Launched May 7: Claude add-ins for Excel, Word, and PowerPoint are now generally available; Outlook is in public beta. All four install from the Microsoft Marketplace in under 5 minutes and work on Windows, Mac, and web versions of Office. Context carries across apps — start a task in Word, continue in Excel without re-explaining. Available to all paid Claude plan subscribers (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) — no separate $30/month Copilot-style add-on fee. The first time an AI-native assistant integrates the full Microsoft 365 suite without requiring an enterprise Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
install: Search 'Claude' in Microsoft Marketplace → Add for each Office app

name: Claude Code v2.1.136–138 (May 8–9)
hook: v2.1.136 (May 8) ships `settings.autoMode.hard_deny` — classifier rules that block unconditionally, closing the retry-loop bypass. MCP servers in `.mcp.json`, plugins, and claude.ai connectors no longer silently vanish after `/clear` (the top community complaint). Daily MCP re-authentication is gone — OAuth refresh tokens now survive concurrent server refreshes. Fixed API 400 errors when extended thinking emits redacted blocks after tool calls. WSL2: Windows clipboard image paste now works via PowerShell fallback. Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` with underscores in project paths. 50+ additional bug fixes. v2.1.137 (May 9): fixes VSCode extension failing to activate on Windows. v2.1.138 (May 9): internal fixes; current latest.

name: Hermes Agent (NousResearch)
hook: 131K GitHub stars in ten weeks — faster than LangChain or AutoGPT reached the same milestone. NousResearch's self-improving agent creates skills from experience, searches past conversations, and builds persistent user models across sessions. v0.12.0 shipped April 30. Runs Claude via OpenRouter or direct API; includes a Claude Code SKILL.md. The self-improvement loop mirrors Anthropic's own 'Dreaming' feature in Managed Agents — the community vs. platform race to make agents improve between runs is now explicit.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 6 — 131K stars; community self-improvement loop continues to contrast with Anthropic's platform-level Dreaming

name: Snyk for Claude Code
hook: Announced May 8: Snyk embedded Anthropic's Claude into the Snyk AI Security Platform via MCP. One command wires Snyk's scanner into Claude Code; Claude then auto-discovers vulnerabilities in code it generates and produces developer-ready fixes, with Claude's reasoning powering both detection and remediation. Enterprise tier adds Evo by Snyk — discovers every AI asset across the org (models, agents, MCP servers, datasets), red-teams running agents for prompt injection and data exfiltration, and enforces runtime policy on tool calls before damage occurs. Requires Snyk CLI v1.1298.0+.

name: n8n-MCP (czlonkowski)
hook: 20.1K stars. MCP server giving Claude Code full access to 1,650 n8n workflow nodes (820 core + 830 community), 2,352 workflow templates, and direct deployment to n8n instances via API. v2.50.4 shipped May 5. name: PAL MCP Server (BeehiveInnovations)
hook: 11.5K stars. Provider Abstraction Layer — rebranded from zen-mcp-server in May. Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI can all orchestrate 50+ models across Gemini, OpenAI, Azure, Grok, and Ollama in a single workflow with conversation continuity preserved. The `clink` feature pipes Claude Code output directly into Gemini CLI (or vice versa) with shared context — cost-routing strategy: Claude for reasoning, Gemini for fast drafts. v2.1.136's OAuth refresh token fix removes PAL's daily re-auth prompt when multiple MCP servers refresh concurrently.

name: Prismatic Skills for Claude Code
hook: Launched May 4 as open-source. Five purpose-built skills turn Claude into an integration specialist: CNI Builder (create or modify code-native TypeScript integrations), Component Builder (build custom API components), Embed Advisor (launch customer-facing integration UIs), Orby (monitor and operate your Prismatic environment), Migration Analyzer (migrate existing integrations to Prismatic). Works alongside the Prism MCP dev server so Claude has both the knowledge and direct platform access. Free for all Prismatic customers on any plan tier.

name: Browserbase Skills
hook: 2.9K stars. 11 Claude Code skills giving agents real browser automation backed by Browserbase's anti-bot infrastructure: browse the web (with stealth mode), deploy Browserbase Functions, debug site rendering, sync cookies, analyze anti-bot detection responses. The anti-bot bypass is the key differentiator — consumer browser MCPs get blocked by Cloudflare and Akamai; Browserbase's infrastructure handles it transparently. Maintained by the Browserbase team; works with the Claude Agent SDK.
